purpose: Give the already accepted B48 one-shot RC4 protection compression exactly one durable retry only when its first synchronous PositionModify result is explicitly transient or outcome-ambiguous and broker reconciliation proves the same owned position still retains the unchanged original stop.

single_checkpoint.name: first_non_successful_synchronous_PositionModify_result_after_durable_B48_compression_journal
single_checkpoint.excluded_retcode_classes: MARKET_CLOSED, FROZEN, generic ERROR, INVALID_*, NO_CHANGES when the target is not already applied, trading-disabled/account/order-state and every retcode outside the closed retryable set
single_checkpoint.mandatory_first_reconciliation: Before deciding whether to retry, select exactly one V6R6-owned RC4 position with the same lifecycle identifier and classify its broker stop as the exact target, the unchanged original stop, or an inconsistency.
single_checkpoint.no_current_quote_contamination: The initial eligibility decision uses only the synchronous result and immediately reconciled owned broker position; a quote is consulted only at the later retry checkpoint.

single_action.name: one_identical_target_retry_on_first_strictly_later_fresh_causal_US30_tick
single_action.durability: The eligible retry intent, initial retcode, strict-after millisecond and unconsumed budget are persisted. Immediately before the only retry submission, the budget is marked consumed and persisted, so restart cannot create a second submission.
single_action.ownership_and_legality: At the first strictly later tick, reselect the same owned position, require the unchanged original stop, a fresh executable quote, an open trading session and the original retained-loss/tightening/minimum-distance legality checks.
single_action.target: The exact journaled B48 target is reused without recalculation, widening or replacement.

outcome_rules.target_already_applied: Adopt the broker target, mark the lifecycle compressed and persist; submit nothing further.
outcome_rules.eligible_original_stop: Persist one retry intent, then consume it before the one later submission.
outcome_rules.nonretryable_original_stop: Clear the request journal, retain the original broker protection and record explicit HOLD.
outcome_rules.retry_non_success_original_stop: Retain the original broker protection and record explicit HOLD; never submit again.
outcome_rules.illegal_first_later_tick: Retain the original broker protection and record explicit HOLD; do not wait for another quote.
outcome_rules.ownership_loss_or_stop_mismatch: Fail closed with broker mismatch and safety stop.
outcome_rules.restart_with_unresolved_submitted_reques: Reconcile only. Adopt the exact target if applied; otherwise retain original protection as HOLD without creating a new retry right.
outcome_rules.position_closed_while_request_or_retry_i: Reconcile the completed owned deal sequence. A target-stop exit follows the existing RC4 shadow path; an original-stop or other normal exit closes the lifecycle without resurrecting the retry.

frozen_economic_contract.compression_target: exact B48 one-shot 25 percent remaining-loss stop

one_time_pre_execution_check.future_leakage: zero: the eligibility branch uses only the returned retcode and immediately reconciled owned stop; retry occurs only on a strictly later observed tick
one_time_pre_execution_check.current_quote_mixing: zero in eligibility; the later causal tick is the declared retry checkpoint and only quote input
one_time_pre_execution_check.entry_change: zero by source and configuration inspection
one_time_pre_execution_check.cost_error: zero: the revision changes no fill, close, accounting, commission, fee, spread, slippage or stress rule
one_time_pre_execution_check.ownership_conflict: zero: fresh source, binary, Portfolio ID, Magic range, settings, report names and state/event/current/lock namespace
